subject: can't read in csv file exported from ActiGraph

messages.author: 04d4632c33dbcb80
messages.subject: can't read in csv file exported from ActiGraph
parts:
Dear Vincent,

My group wanted to use GGIR to analyze accelerometer data from ActiGraph. We exported the csv file. However, we got an error message as below. Can you send me or share with me a sample csv file exported from ActiGraph that could be read in the GGIR package so that we know how to format the data in order to use your package?

> datafile="/Users/summer/
Downloads/ActiGraph/1002_MOS2C3514107110sec AGD Details Epochs 2017-05-02_11-05-44.csv"
> g.inspectfile(datafile)
Error in data.frame(value = H[, 2], row.names = H[, 1]) :
  duplicate row.names: 10/9/14
>

Thanks a lot!

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] can't read in csv file exported from ActiGraph
parts:
This question was asked before, see here which includes an example file.

You can contribute to GGIR by forking the repostory, investigate how the code could be improved, and then when you think it works: make a pull request. Next, I will review the chances and if all goes well it will be part of the next version of GGIR.

Thanks, Vincent
